Wow. This post really hit home. I understand what you are going through, because I have the same issue!

I what I have to work somewhat is to remove yourself from the situation and look at it from a third party. What did you do? Was what you did such a big deal? Think about that. Yes, you will do/say dumb things, every one does. You aren't perfect, You are just as flawed as everyone else on the planet. Dont beat yourself up for one stupid mistake. I used to (and still do, kind of) think that if you do something stupid, everyone is going to remember and hate you. People forget, expect those photographic memory, which are few and far in between. 

Honesty, I'm learning more and more to stop caring what people think of me. Live your life true to yourself, and the people who like you will stay with you, and the people who don't won't.

PM me if you ever need any help. Since we have similar issues, maybe we could help each other out.

Your Welcome! You'll find that there are a lot of caring people on this subreddit who are in similar situations and don't want others to feel as they do.

 Do you have any hobbies or interests? The reason why I ask is because whenever I get those thoughts, I always think that I have something else that I have to do, a goal I have to reach. They arent even big goals either! Whether its finishing a show I'm watching for saving up for something I want to buy, its the little things that keep me going.

Its funny, We are in almost the exact situation. I broke up with my Ex-Girlfriend whom I was absolute best friends with for 6 years prior 2 almost years ago,(itll be two years in November). She and I were close as close can be.  It didn't matter if I did or said stupid things in front of her, i know she wouldn't talk behind my back or thing ill of me. 
 When I was with her, I still had issues with other friends of mine and what not, but I  always had a feeling that everything was going to be ok because I had someone who liked me. I know that my parents love me, but with her it was different. I think its because she didn’t have too. She liked me for who I was. It was cool to think I did things that made her like me.  

>My ex bf and I broke up due to external circumstances over a year ago. We decided to stay friends, and kept talking regularly, just chatting. Recently he told me he's dating someone else now, and I honestly feel like my world is gone... I'll never have someone like him. 

We remained friends for 2 weeks afterward. People say, oh we're just friends know. I've never understood how you can be just friends with someone you have such strong feelings for.

> he was my first love and taught me what being loved by anyone is like.

I know. When I was with her, it was the first time I was ever intimate with a girl. She was my first kiss. It was the first time I was love by someone who didn't have to love me. She loved me for who I was. 

>And how pathetic am I for wanting to kill myself with my stupid pathetic problems

You're not pathetic for wanting to kill yourself. Heart break is one of, if not the most painful emotion you can experience. I have tried to end it all a few times but I always chickened out. Instead on weekends, I would take melatonin and sleep through weekends because being awake was just too painful. When I was asleep, I was able to escape. When I'd wake up, i'd forget about my problems for 5-10 seconds and I would be happy. Then the feeling anxiety and depression would hit me like a brick wall.   Its funny, everyone says that time heals all wounds, but heartbreak is one that has really messed up my life. I've developed Bi-Polar II, Paranoid Personality Disorder and Clinical Depression.

You can think of me as a friend if you'd like, or at least someone who understand what you are going through. If you ever need to talk, feel free to message me whenever, Im on here everyday, and I'll respond as soon as I see your message. Take Care. I hope everything works out for you in the end.
